cells_genuine_or_noise.c1_code: nao medido (+2.4% vs 0.0% de ruido da celula, mas c=1 e instavel entre boots)

design: A/B/A, one boot per config, decode 20s windows c=1/c=4 prose+code, prefill 8K/16K, bench check per boot
drafter: dspark (the drafter that instantiates the MXFP8 projections; with dflash they are never built and the knob is inert - see docs/RECIPE_DECISIONS.md)
experiment: MXFP8 linear backend: marlin (qualified) vs b12x (engine's SM12x-native family)
noise_is_not_uniform: prefill is measured precisely (run-to-run 0.4-0.6%); decode c=1 prose and c=4 prose carry 3.8-4.2% boot spread. Judge each cell against its own spread, not one global band.
note: medida de par unico (antonius + spark-8352); PROFILE_MEASURED permanece 0
verdict: nao adotado. prefill 16K -4.0% contra ruido de 0.4-0.6% = perda real; c=1 prose -7.4% contra 4.2% = provavel perda; prefill 8K -0.5% contra 0.6% = neutro; os tres ganhos de decode (+2.4%, +4.8%, +2.8%) estao todos dentro da faixa de ruido daquelas celulas, ou seja, nao medidos. Nenhum ganho demonstrado e ao menos uma perda real: marlin continua o default.
why: the vLLM launch blog's PrimiTS drafter path is gated to sm_100/103/107 and refused on GB10 (sm_121); b12x is the runnable SM12x alternative
